name: Holly bend (ambush site)
region: Lordaeron farm road below the hills, past the abandoned farms, a bend where the left hedge gives out

sensoryProfile.sight: A wood of oak and ash coming down to the road with holly thick underneath; ditches either side; deer and wolves with filmed milk-white eyes; blood in the ditch water; ice on the road going pink at the edges
sensoryProfile.sound: Ripping crash of branches, thud of hooves, wolves silent, bowstrings slapping bracers; then only wind and breath
sensoryProfile.smell: Wet hide, blood, the cabbage-field sweetness
sensoryProfile.touch: Cold ditch water over boot tops; hot belly of the opened doe
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Silence before the burst, then violence; afterward the rangers hold the road facing out

establishedFacts.fact: The staff hums and Windrunner stops before the bend: deer, then a young stag, then wolves, burst out of the holly down the crown of the road toward the riders, eyes white and filmed like skin on boiled milk.

Casualties: lead doe (Sylvanas's first shot dropped her), stag (Lyriel), a wolf (Neral's horse), a wolf frozen to the road by Jaina and shot through the eye by Lyriel, the second doe (arrow behind the shoulder, one in the neck, finished by Cyndia's headshot). Three or four wolves, fate of the rest unstated (one is the Neral kill, one is Lyriel's). Neral's grey has a shallow cut on the near hock; bay sound.
Cyndia: deer slots and wolf pads in the same track as far back into the holly as she could follow; no wolf tracks spread for running; nothing was chasing anything.
The wolves' coats are coming away in patches, skin grey and scabbed beneath; the lead doe's eye film is thick, yellowish and cracked at the edges, 'old varnish on a door'.

A second doe took a green-fletched arrow behind the shoulder (Sylvanas later says 'That one had my arrow through the heart') and a neck shot and kept coming, bleeding from the nose in two strings. Jaina's examination: the contamination lies through blood, meat, organs, liver worst then lungs; the belly runs hot like a dung heap; the liver is swollen, soft as an overripe plum; the doe was infected long before she died. Sylvanas cut open the doe from the last rib back at Jaina's direction.

eventsHere.event: Ambush by contaminated deer and wolves; Jaina's frost sheet; Jaina reads the doe to the elbow; Sylvanas asks 'Is it in my horses?'
